content:
name: Test

on:
    push:
        branches: ['**']
    pull_request:
        branches: ['**']

permissions:
    contents: read

jobs:
    test:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
            - run: corepack enable
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
            - run: pnpm lint
            - run: pnpm test:types
            - run: pnpm test
            - run: pnpm --filter tailwind-merge build
            - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
              with:
                  name: build-output
                  path: packages/tailwind-merge/dist
                  if-no-files-found: error
            - run: pnpm --filter tailwind-merge test:exports
            # The vite package's build and packed-tarball gate come after the library's build on purpose: the gate resolves tailwind-merge through its published shape (dist and types), which the library build above just produced.
            - run: pnpm --filter @tailwind-merge/vite build
            - run: pnpm --filter @tailwind-merge/vite test:exports
            # Same for the Next.js package: its gate runs a real `next build` of a consumer app against the packed tarball, resolving the library through the build above.
            - run: pnpm --filter @tailwind-merge/next build
            - run: pnpm --filter @tailwind-merge/next test:exports
